text:
maria: Quick idea for canary -> full: 'progressive shadow' where new variant runs fully mirrored but we flip routing in steps while keeping a fast rollback path. Thinking about cache priming, external side-effects, and clear telemetry gates.

kevin: I like running a real mirror first. main questions: how do we avoid double side-effects (billing, webhooks) and stale cache reads on the mirrored path?

maria: Proposal: start mirror as read-only (no writes to downstream), observe warmup and metrics. Then enable write-duplication behind a tenant-scoped feature flag (opt-in). Finally commit route once divergence < threshold.

aj: Could we instead capture writes into a replay buffer (write-ahead log) per tenant? Only replay on commit, dedupe on the external side to avoid duplicates. That keeps live systems clean until we decide to flip.

lina: We need explicit gating signals. Suggest: p95 latency delta, error-rate delta, sampled eval failure, and KV cache hit-ratio slope. Also an ML quality metric (prompt-set regression).

maria: Draft gating set:
- sample_eval_fail_rate <= 1% absolute
- p95_latency <= 1.3x baseline
- error_rate_increase <= 0.2% absolute
- kv_cache_stability: hit-ratio slope ~0 for 15m
- token_quality_regressions <= 1%

kevin: Add cost guardrails; mirroring doubles inference cost per request. Have soft/hard budget limits per tenant: soft -> alert and reduce shadow pct; hard -> stop shadowing.

maria: Agreed. Also an auto-stop when budget breached.

aj: For output divergence detection: deterministic compare when model is determinable, otherwise a fuzzy-similarity score (embedding distance) and a failure threshold.

devx: UX: console should show a side-by-side "shadow delta" view per route: metric pairs, gating status (green/yellow/red), top mismatched samples with links to traces, and a single-click rollback.

lina: Define escape hatches: immediate cut (route 100% back), staged rollback (stop writes, drain mirror), and quarantine (isolate both variants and cut traffic). Each with an explicit runbook.

kevin: Edge-case: customers with external side-effects probably already require idempotent webhooks. If not, we must queue outbound side-effects and commit on flip. Also consider tenant-level policy to opt out of mirrored side-effects.

maria: We'll add a side-queue commit mode for external integrations. Default: queue+dedupe, on final cutover replay to downstream with idempotency keys.

aj: Operational test: schedule a chaos run (CPU spike + latency jitter) while shadowing to validate rollback triggers fire and circuit paths behave.

devx: I'll prototype a console mock and a small playbook to show operators what to click and what each gating light means.

maria: Example canary config I sketched: 
```
canary:
  strategy: progressive_shadow
  initial_mode: read-only-mirror
  mirror_pct: 100
  warmup: 10m
  enable_write_duplication: false
  side_effect_mode: queue_commit
  gates:
    eval_sample_pct: 0.5
    telemetry_window: 5m
  rollback_triggers:
    p95_multiplier: 1.3
    error_delta_pct: 0.2
    eval_fail_pct: 1.0
  budget:
    soft_limit_usd: 200
    hard_limit_usd: 500
```

kevin: Small nit: change mirror_pct -> mirror_mode_pct to make it clear that mirror behavior depends on mode (read-only vs dup vs replay).

maria: Good rename, will update.

lina: For long-term, centralize gating rules in a small DSL so product teams can reuse signals; publish default recommended gate sets. RFC forthcoming.

aj: Also expose a divergence API so teams can programmatic check outliers and automate pre-commit checks.

sre-bot: deploy-batch: canary-runner triggered for inference-runtime run_id=20260207-17 start=1719456950

maria: Proposed rollout plan: shadow 5% of tenants for 24h (read-only), if gates pass enable write-dup for those tenants for 6h (still mirroring), then promote to 25% traffic with mirroring until stable.

aj: +1. add a forced cooldown period after write-dup enable before commit to let caches settle.

kevin: Also add tenant opt-outs: some sensitive tenants should never be mirrored. enforce via tenant policy.

maria: Will include tenant policy and API for opt-out. Drafting RFC now; pinging @kevin @devx for review.

deploy-bot: config-update: maria updated canary configs (PR #4121) CI passed.

devx: Will attach console mock + runbook draft by EOD.

lina: LGTM once RFC + runbook added.

maria: Thanks folks. Scheduling follow-up sync Tue.
